concept.role: Original material/organism concept only, not an identity-matched asset or in-engine evidence
concept.prompt: Original character material and organism design concept, not a game screenshot. An adult orbital rescue worker in a grounded worn ivory ceramic and graphite pressure suit, standing three-quarter view from knees upward against a plain desaturated grey background, readable neutral studio light. The worker has survived a violent struggle and been colonized by an original alien organism: one shoulder and the right neck seam are forced apart by overlapping curved chalk-grey calcified lamellae, like irregular broken marine shell fins rather than spikes. Dark olive fibrous roots grow beneath the chest harness and through torn fabric; a small exposed wound shows muted raw maroon tissue only inside the split seam, with restrained dry rust-brown blood. One chest armor plate is buckled and partially detached, straps frayed, metal scraped and punctured. A smooth dark tinted pressure visor remains mostly intact with a jagged lower-side breach revealing tiny pale root structures in the shadow, not a human face. Asymmetric original silhouette with an inward-curled hollow growth near the shoulder, subtle contracted posture. Disturbing biological infestation with plausible layered material and contact depth, high-end science fiction horror concept, no neon glow, no generic glowing spikes, no giant tentacles, no detached limbs, no exposed organs, no heavy gore, no bodies, no franchise symbols or recognizable creatures, no text, no watermark. It should read as a damaged rescue suit being invaded from within, not a clean toy robot or a red repaint.
